name: photon-beam

frames.best_why: The core is brightest here and the most signal dots are visible along the lanes.

tagline: Cyan light signals race along a fan of thin lines in a dark 3D field.
summary: A full-bleed dark backdrop of many fine curved lines that converge at a bright point on the left and run off to the right. Small glowing cyan pulses travel along the lanes under a soft bloom.
appearance: An almost black scene. From a small white-cyan core at the left middle, dozens of hair-thin lines fan out and bend into nearly horizontal lanes that stretch to the right edge, with fog dimming the far end. Tiny bright dots sit on some lanes and everything glows softly.
behaviour: The lines breathe with a slow wave while bright signal dots race left to right along individual lanes, each trailing a short fading tail, then restart on a random lane. A bloom pass makes the core and signals glow; nothing responds to the pointer.
search_phrases: dark hero with neon light streaks
use_when: A dark hero, login screen or product panel needs a moving light field that stays abstract behind text.
avoid_when: It runs a WebGL loop with bloom every frame, so it is heavy on laptops and the bright core pulls focus.
customise: Twenty colour, geometry, wave, signal, speed and bloom values are props, including background, line and signal colours, line count, spread, wave speed, trail length and bloom strength.
weight_why: Eighty animated lines and 94 signal trails are redrawn every frame through a bloom pass.

a11y.note: The canvas is decorative with no label, and the animation ignores prefers-reduced-motion, so it keeps running for motion-sensitive users.

polish_why: Crisp bloom and real depth; the core crowds the left edge and brightness varies between frames.
title: Photon Beam
